errors.description: MATCHED PAIR GATE FAILURE. The arc and diamond photographs are effectively indistinguishable: both render a plain straight horizontal welt opening. None of the three drawn discriminators survived - the short vertical leg dropping from the waistband, the smooth rounded elbow at the side seam, and the parallel topstitch line just inside the band.
errors.expected: an L-shaped mouth: a short vertical leg under the belt loop, a small-radius squared corner, a near-level run, then a smooth ROUNDED turn down at the seam, with a parallel topstitch line inside the band
errors.actual: a plain straight horizontal welt pocket with no vertical leg, no rounded elbow and no topstitch
errors.correction: Describe the mouth as an explicit vertex path with the corner radii named, and require the topstitch to be visible as a separate parallel line. Shoot arc and diamond as a pair and reject unless the rounded-versus-angular elbow and the presence-versus-absence of the topstitch are both readable.
